svg.title: Communities of Nacre — a cross-border reference
svg.desc: An index of six invented ethnic identities and five invented religions. Rows list the ten countries alphabetically with their flags. Separate sets of marks show the country examples for each kind of identity.
svg.text: Fictional ethnic identities and religions · Illustrative overlap across borders
